flaps._comment: Longitude operator guide documents four flap detents: UP 0 degrees, 1 at 7 degrees limited to 250 KIAS, 2 at 15 degrees limited to 230 KIAS, and FULL at 35 degrees limited to 180 KIAS.

grades._comment: Provisional super-midsize jet landing bands pending Longitude-specific in-sim verification.

lvars._comment: This profile uses documented standard SimVars only; no Working Title-specific telemetry routes are enabled.

spoilers._comment: The Longitude guide documents speedbrakes and automated ground spoilers but does not define an external armed/readback variable, so this profile uses standard percent handling only.

controls._comment: Only standard gear/flaps surface fallback is allowed. Autothrottle, TO/GA, FMS, autopilot/FGP, speedbrake, and ground-spoiler writes remain unavailable until verified.

meta.notes: Source-backed profile for the Premium Deluxe Cessna Citation Longitude. The Working Title operator guide gives strong flap and speedbrake context but does not define an external variable/control interface, so custom telemetry and cockpit writes stay inactive.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 FAQ - aircraft matrix
sources.notes: Lists Cessna Citation Longitude as included with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Premium Deluxe and Aviator editions.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator - Aircraft Manuals
sources.notes: Provides a Cessna Citation Longitude Model 700 operator's guide from Working Title. The page does not publish an external telemetry/control variable map.

sources.name: Cessna Citation Longitude Model 700 Operator's Guide
sources.notes: Documents Longitude flaps UP/1/2/FULL with 0/7/15/35 degrees and VFE limits of 250/230/180 KIAS, speedbrakes, automated ground spoilers, and go-around procedure. No external LVAR/B-var/control variable list is provided.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 Avionics Framework - SimVars
sources.notes: Documents standard MSFS SimVars/A-vars as queryable simulator state. This profile intentionally activates no aircraft-specific L: or B: variables.

knownIssues: Exact MSFS 2024 Longitude title strings remain unverified in-sim.
Flap detents are manual-backed, but their runtime handle-index order still needs in-sim verification.
The cited sources do not define a Longitude external LVAR, B-var, or input-event map.
Autothrottle, TO/GA, autopilot/FGP, speedbrake, and spoiler-arm controls remain unavailable until exact semantic writes are verified.
